verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch explicitly supports organizing requests into collections and folders with single-click reuse (hoppscotch-gh-11), collection-level auth/header inheritance (hoppscotch-docs-4), OpenAPI import with tags-as-folders (hoppscotch-docs-15), and CLI-based collection running/automation (hoppscotch-docs-8). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of folder-level nesting/reuse workflow and richer documentation on advanced folder management beyond changelog mentions.
